ns2:section.sectionText: Topic: Proseminar in Human Factors. The purpose of the seminar is to present the student with an understanding of the methodology, content, and research process in human factors. One aspect focuses on the current content of human factors research with an emphasis on faculty research on this campus. The second aspect examines the process of human factors research, addressing the particular issues in experimental design, data analysis, write up, and presentation that are relatively unique to applied psychological research. Prior background in human factors is neither a requirement, nor even expected. It is however important that the student be interested in the applications of psychological theory to applied problems, especially to problems in human-computer interaction and human interaction with technology more generally. This section meets with PSYC 593 ACK, 38128.
